purpose: plan item 5: direct unembedding of injected vectors vs downstream R/J readouts
primary_readout: W_U @ v (raw unembedding, as in the source paper)
secondary_readout: W_U @ (g * v), g = final-norm output for an all-ones input
family_score_direct: mean over the family's probe tokens of the direct logit, z-scored over the full vocabulary
family_score_downstream: mean over prompts and the family's probes of log(rank_baseline / rank_condition), plane sweep

predictions.V1: Primary readout: direct(-S2) ranks calm_positive above activated_vitality (source paper: calm and relaxed sit at S2's negative end).
predictions.V2: Pearson r across the 60 probes between direct(-S2) z-logit and downstream R-lens log-rank gain is higher at layer 16 than at layer 29 (probe-bootstrap 95% CI of r16 - r29 excludes 0 upward).

exploratory: top promoted/suppressed word tokens per injected vector; family tables; r by layer for all four vectors, both lenses, both readouts.
